summary: Clackamas County, OR: three 1930s crow's nests along a ridgetop, listed as abandoned; no source says what remains at the site today.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only history is one firelookout.com line and the FFLA entry (Crowsnest, Abandoned). The Forest Lookouts page gives only the name and 3S-7E-15, so it is not cited. No staffing, fire, or site description found. The 1930s date is a decade, so no dated events are recorded. The Devil's Peak Lookout is on the same Hunchback Ridge trail but no source ties it to these nests; the story warns against conflating them. The record's kind 'platform' is kept, since the vocabulary includes crow's nests.
